Mapping backend
|
|-- Agent tool requests
|   [IN: API > MCP tools -- "Tool calls"]
|   |
|   |-- MCP adapter or direct HTTP client
|   |   `-- POST /api/mapping/agent/tools/{toolName}
|   |       `-- handleAgentRoutes -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService.call()
|   |           |-- Validate arguments against agentToolSchemas
|   |           |-- Deduplicate requestId / reject changed retries
|   |           `-- Route to the operation below
|   |
|   |-- Execute canvas operations
|   |   [IN: API > exec -- "Canvas operations"]
|   |   |
|   |   |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime.run(): execute restricted JavaScript
|   |   |   |-- Validate canvas / nodes / edges methods
|   |   |   |-- Resolve sessionId to canvasId + documentId
|   |   |   `-- Convert mutations into DiagramOperation values
|   |   |
|   |   |-- Target: live browser canvas
|   |   |   `-- CanvasSessionBridge.dispatch()
|   |   |       |-- Queue a CanvasCommand for the target document
|   |   |       |-- Browser polls /agent/canvases/{id}/commands
|   |   |       |   `-- handleAgentCommand() executes the browser operation
|   |   |       |-- Browser posts its result to /reply
|   |   |       `-- reply() resolves the waiting request -> agent
|   |   |
|   |   `-- Target: proposal selected by changeSessionId
|   |       `-- ChangeSessionService.apply()
|   |           |-- MappingDocumentController.applyUpdate()
|   |           |   |-- Check expectedVersion
|   |           |   `-- Apply operations to the isolated copy
|   |           `-- Persist edits -> refresh Changes tab previews
|   |
|   |-- Manage proposal lifecycle
|   |   `-- ChangeSessionService
|   |       |-- create(): capture saved canvases and live drafts
|   |       |   `-- Open isolated proposal documents
|   |       `-- accept(): check session version and original revisions
|   |           |-- acceptCanvasChanges(): publish canvases together
|   |           `-- Freeze proposal and retain review history
|   |
|   |-- Prompt-driven edits
|   |   `-- DiagramEditService
|   |       |-- generation and application run state
|   |       |-- status / cancellation
|   |       `-- retain generated revision for application retry
|   |
|   |-- Read diagrams
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.search()
|   |       |-- Live document -> snapshot() through the browser bridge
|   |       `-- Saved diagram -> representation catalog
|   |
|   |-- Publish: save_diagram
|   |   `-- saveNow(): capture live snapshot through the bridge
|   |       `-- MappingDiagramService.save()
|   |           |-- Write catalog revision
|   |           `-- Dispatch "saved" acknowledgement to browser
|   |
|   `-- Mutation contract
|       |-- Each exec mutation commits with its own undo step
|       |-- Earlier commits survive a later script failure
|       `-- sessionId identifies attachment; expectedVersion guards edits
|
|-- LiveCanvasService
|   |-- selection mirror and attached readers
|   `-- AgentContextService
|       |-- receive scoped trajectory uploads
|       `-- resolve agentContextId for diagram editing
|
|-- Persist workspace
|   [IN: API > POST /workspace/records -- "Workspace HTTP"]
|   |
|   |-- GET /workspace/records -> MappingWorkspaceService.loadRecords()
|   |-- POST /workspace/records -> MappingWorkspaceService.applyBatch()
|   |   `-- Persist an atomic batch of workspace records
|   `-- GET / PUT /workspace -> load() / save() full snapshots
|
`-- Run application features
    [IN: API > POST /prompt -- "Feature HTTP"]
    |
    |-- /diagrams    -> MappingDiagramService.save() / delete()
    |-- /prompt      -> SelectionService.prepare() / run()
    |-- /chat        -> LocalChatService.prepare() / reply()
    `-- /compactions -> FileCompactionService.prepare() / run() / get()
